summary: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group filed a Form 6-K providing a progress report on its ongoing share repurchase program. The board authorized repurchase of up to 40 million shares (1% of outstanding) for up to JPY 180 billion from May 14 to July 31, 2026. As of May 31, 2026, 5,439,500 shares were repurchased for JPY 32,393,160,200 through market purchases under a discretionary dealing contract. This is a routine open-market buyback under Japanese companies law, equivalent to a US issuer tender or capital return. No premium, advisor, or regulatory hurdles are involved. Watch for the speed of buyback execution relative to the July deadline.
